chunks: Narrated to us by the illustrious Shaykh Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him), who said: Narrated to us Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Jafar al-Hamdani (may God be pleased with him), who said: Narrated to us Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdami, from Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Musa ibn Jafar, from his father Jafar ibn Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

Whoever perfects his ablution, beautifies his prayers, pays the zakat of his wealth, guards his tongue, withholds his anger, seeks forgiveness for his sin, and fulfills the duty of sincere counsel regarding the household of His Messenger, has indeed perfected the realities of faith, and the gates of Paradise are open for him.

key_terms.أسبغ وضوءه: asbagha wudu'ahu -- to perfect and complete one's ritual ablution
key_terms.استكمل حقائق الإيمان: istakmal haqa'iq al-iman -- perfected the realities of faith; attaining the full truth and essence of belief
key_terms.النصيحة لأهل البيت: al-nasihah li-ahl al-bayt -- sincere counsel and loyalty regarding the Prophet's household

ai.seo_question: What are the seven qualities that perfect faith according to the Prophet Muhammad in al-Amali al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) said: Whoever perfects his ablution, beautifies his prayers, pays the zakat of his wealth, guards his tongue, withholds his anger, seeks forgiveness for his sins, and fulfills the duties of sincere counsel regarding the household of His Messenger, has indeed perfected the realities of faith, and the gates of Paradise are open for him. This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching Imam al-Kadhim and Imam al-Sadiq (AS) from their forefathers, enumerates seven comprehensive qualities that together constitute the complete realization of true faith.
